job.rawJd:
Cinder provides an AI-native platform for trust, safety, and risk. The Agent Product Manager helps design, deploy, and scale AI-powered systems for enterprise customers. This is a hands-on, forward-deployed product role working directly with customers to understand workflows, risks, and goals, then using Cinder's platform to build and iterate on AI-driven solutions in high-stakes environments.

The role moves between product thinking and execution: shaping solutions with customers, partnering with Engineering and Design, and feeding field insight into Cinder's product roadmap. Responsibilities include designing, configuring, and iterating on AI agents through prompt logic, workflows, and policies; understanding customer workflows, pain points, and risk tolerance; optimizing systems based on real-world performance; advising operators and executives on safe AI deployment and adoption; defining success and tradeoffs; representing Cinder in customer conversations; translating customer pain points into product signals and roadmap input; prioritizing platform improvements from real usage; and supporting pilots, launches, deployments, expansions, and key customer moments with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Design, and Leadership.

Candidates should have at least two years of relevant experience in product management, consulting, engineering, operations, or a similar problem-solving role; strong technical intuition around AI- or ML-powered systems without needing to train models; comfort working directly with customers in ambiguous or high-stakes situations; clear communication across technical and non-technical audiences; and the ability to help define the playbook while executing day to day.

Preferred experience includes AI agents, LLM-powered products, or ML-driven workflows; Trust & Safety, risk, fraud, integrity, or compliance-adjacent work; embedded enterprise customer experience in a technical, advisory, or forward-deployed role; and comfort operating between product strategy and hands-on execution. The position is based in New York City and is hybrid.
